name: Le Meridien Columbus, The Joseph
insider_take: This isn't just a hotel—it's Columbus's most sophisticated cultural hub where modern luxury meets Midwestern authenticity.
whats_special: The Joseph stands as Columbus's first and only autograph collection property, featuring an impressive contemporary art collection throughout its spaces. Located in the heart of the Short North Arts District, the hotel showcases local artists and serves as a gateway to Columbus's thriving creative scene. The building itself is a stunning example of modern architecture that perfectly complements the neighborhood's eclectic mix of galleries, boutiques, and restaurants.
pro_tip: Book a room on the upper floors facing east for spectacular views of downtown Columbus and the Scioto Mile—especially stunning during sunset when the city lights begin to twinkle.
dont_miss: The monthly Gallery Hop in the Short North (first Saturday of every month) is just steps away—it's one of the country's most celebrated art walks. Also, the hotel's rooftop bar offers craft cocktails with panoramic city views, and you're within walking distance of the historic North Market, Ohio's last remaining public market and a foodie paradise since 1876.
pros: Prime downtown Columbus location in the Short North Arts District
Contemporary art-focused design with curated local artwork throughout
Modern luxury amenities including state-of-the-art fitness center
Sophisticated dining and cocktail venues on-site
cons: Urban location may have limited parking availability
Premium pricing typical of luxury downtown hotels
